observedDifferences.expected: git push can publish the release tag with the active credential
observedDifferences.actual: the environment GITHUB_TOKEN had repo scope but no workflow scope and GitHub rejected the tag because the candidate history contains a workflow file
observedDifferences.correction: use the existing keyring credential with repo and workflow scopes for the tag and release commands without changing persistent authentication

observedDifferences.expected: one gh release create command uploads all assets and publishes
observedDifferences.actual: the first long upload left a temporary draft with only SHA256SUMS.txt and then rolled it back
observedDifferences.correction: create a draft first, upload each asset independently, verify all server digests, then publish explicitly

observedDifferences.expected: gh release view exposes an isLatest JSON field
observedDifferences.actual: the installed gh version does not expose isLatest
observedDifferences.correction: verify latest status through the official releases/latest API endpoint
